LanguageData.AG_AjinResetSlow: The slow Reset: he rises where he fell, anchors ignored.

LanguageData.AG_GhostAlreadyOut: The Black Ghost is already out.
LanguageData.AG_GhostTargetSelfOrAnchor: Target Satō or one of his anchors.
LanguageData.AG_GhostGoDesc: Send the Black Ghost to a cell. It guards that spot and fights enemies near it.
LanguageData.AG_GhostAttackDesc: Send the Black Ghost after one enemy.
LanguageData.AG_GhostTearDesc: The Black Ghost grabs an enemy and rips an arm or a leg off. An arm drops its weapon; a second leg downs it. Once per summon, fleshy enemies only.
